[[Factory]] |next =[[Streets of Tarkov]] |chapter = |enemies =[[Scav Raiders]] |players =8-10 |difficulty = |duration =30 minutes |notable loot = }} '''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a [[Map of Tarkov|location]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''. It is the sixth map that was added to the game. ==Description== Secret underground TerraGroup Labs facility hidden right under the center of Tarkov. Officially, this research center does not exist and, based on data scraps, is engaged in research and development as well as testing and simulation of projects in chemistry, physics, biology, and other high technology. ==Notes== * {{PAGENAME}} is initially only accessible by [[Transits|transiting]]. Direct access from the location selection screen is unlocked upon progressing through the story chapter [[Tour]]. * This location can only be entered with a [[TerraGroup Labs access keycard]]. ==Features== ===Insurance=== All insured items left in a raid by players will not be returned. Upon death, insurance [[Traders]] will send the usual in-game mail about dispatching people to recover the items, but when the insurance timer runs out they will explain that their people don't go to the location, didn't find it or died in the process. [[File:TheLab-Insurance-Messages-01.PNG]] ===Illumination=== The illumination can be disabled by turning off the power in the basement.
  • File:LabsIlluminationPowerButtonMap.png|Power button location marked on basement map File:LabsIlluminationPowerButton.png|The power button
    • ===Announcer=== Whenever an event of high importance happens, an announcement will be triggered. There is an announcement for every extraction activation besides "Ventilation Shaft" and "Sewage Conduit". The announcement for the "Parking Gate" extraction can be disabled inside the alarm system control panel room. A [[TerraGroup Labs keycard (Yellow)|Yellow keycard]] is needed to enter it.
